title: Built-up RC wing
summary: NACA ribs, spar slots, stall speed
description: A built-up balsa wing for a radio-controlled model from its span, chords, NACA digits, sweep, washout and flying weight: every rib cut from a lofted wing with its spar slots, leading and trailing edge stock, a ply joiner and film, and the numbers an aeromodeller wants.
process: Laser cutting of ribs from balsa sheet; stick-built on a board; film or sheet covering

difficulty.rationale: Formula airfoil, ruled lofts, rib pattern booleans and coupled range formulas over one wing.

standards: NACA Report No. 824, Summary of Airfoil Data (Abbott, von Doenhoff, Stivers, 1945), Appendix I p. 100: NACA 2412, 1412, 0009 ordinates (read, scanned page)
NASA TM-4741, Ladson et al., NACA 4-digit thickness polynomial coefficients
Airfield Models, mean aerodynamic chord of a tapered wing
NASA Glenn, the lift equation; International Standard Atmosphere, sea-level density and viscosity
Selig et al., Summary of Low-Speed Airfoil Data Vol. 2, Appendix B: NACA 2414 section lift at low Reynolds number (basis of the stated CLmax of 1.0)
materials: Balsa leading and trailing edge stock
